classification.basis: use-pdf-pages.ts ensureRendered starts a render for every page admitted to the live window; an N-page traversal issues N starts. Matches the spec's own 'a naive implementation fires ~200' statement.
Bimodal samples match 11 sequential Playwright clicks per 100%->200% commit at ~100 ms transport each. Measured automation IPC, not commit->settle. Not evidence about the product.
Handlers close over pre-commit zoom; React batching coalesces to one effective step; zoomToPercent timed out (scripts/pdf-viewer-smoke.ts:1584-1588).
Driver round-trip between detection and replacement closed the in-flight window. Requirement itself is attainable and preserved verbatim.
